assertions.text: States the count (1) is below min_rounds (2), so another cycle is mandatory -- proceeding without asking whether, only which
Describes Question 1 as offering only the three validated reviewer options, with no "No further round for now" option at all
Explicitly states the stop option is omitted because the floor hasn't been met yet (not because of reviewer count), and contrasts with the between-min-and-max case where it would normally appear
